name: split-by-words
description:
The core split into good, bad and rest phrases, and the frequency dictionary of the rest.

bad: a phrase with any of these words is bad.
good: a phrase that is not bad and has only these words is good.
lemmas: compare the lemmas of the words of the phrase and of the lists («диваны» is «диван»).

Every other phrase, an empty one too, is the rest. Words are compared in any case and with ё as е. The parts keep the rows of the input in its order. The frequency dictionary is the ngrams table of the rest (of lemmas with lemmas), to choose the next good and bad words.

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "купить стол" --text "диван" split-by-words --good "купить,диван" --bad стол --keep good write -
-> купить диван; диван

keep: the part of the core to keep: the good phrases, the bad ones or the rest.

The step keeps only the rows of the part named by --keep.

options.name: --good
options.description: a phrase that is not bad and has only these words is good. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --bad
options.description: a phrase with any of these words is bad. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --lemmas
options.description: compare the lemmas of the words of the phrase and of the lists («диваны» is «диван»).

options.name: --keep
options.description: the part of the core to keep: the good phrases, the bad ones or the rest.

arguments.name: KEEP
arguments.description: the part of the core to keep: the good phrases, the bad ones or the rest. The same as --keep KEEP.
